params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in response. Anonymous callers may use `view` and `embed` only.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: type
params.description: Limit results to items of an object type.

params.name: subtype
params.description: Limit results to items of one or more object subtypes.

items.docs: Cross-content search returning lightweight result objects (id, title, url, type, subtype) with _links to the full object. The most efficient way to locate an Alloplex press release or corporate page by keyword.
